regions.summary: Store the most recent result, continue the two-way loop and return the saved result when done.

units.name: B20_ReturnSavedGridVariant
units.summary: Store the most recent result, continue the two-way loop and return the saved result when done.

units.name: B20_EnterCompiledNativeFrame
units.summary: Remove the helper return and caller return words. Save the eight-byte VM context plus saved-local count in a nine-byte frame, copy the requested $80-based local registers, allocate the declared stack extent, and enter native code four bytes after its descriptor. Native entry has A=X=0,Y=1.

units.name: B20_LeaveCompiledNativeFrame
units.summary: Restore the saved local-register bytes and eight-byte VM context, then jump to the caller continuation. This is the matching native-frame epilogue.

units.name: B20_NativeMultiplyWords
units.summary: Load the two addressed register pairs, use three MMC5 byte products to form the low 16 bits of their product, store at the destination pair, and restore A=X=0,Y=1.

units.name: B20_NativeSignedQuotient
units.summary: Divide magnitudes, then restore the quotient sign from the exclusive-or of operand signs.

units.name: B20_NativeUnsignedQuotient
units.summary: Divide unsigned register pairs and store the quotient.

units.name: B20_NativeUnsignedRemainder
units.summary: Divide unsigned register pairs and store the remainder.

units.name: B20_NativeSignedRemainder
units.summary: Divide magnitudes and restore the dividend sign on the remainder.

units.name: B20_NativeDivideUnsignedCore
units.summary: Preserve the destination selector and enter the 16-round restoring division loop.

units.name: B20_NativeDivideSignedCore
units.summary: Save dividend and quotient signs, negate negative inputs, then perform unsigned restoring division. Zero-divisor behavior follows the literal loop and is not separately checked.

units.name: B20_LoadNativeBinaryOperands
units.summary: Read source register pairs selected by X/Y into scratch words $42/$44 while preserving the helper return address; return the destination selector in A.

units.name: B20_CallInlineNativeTarget
units.summary: Consume a three-byte descriptor after JSR: target word then stack extent. Allocate the VM stack frame, move hardware-stack arguments there, jump to the target and unwind by the descriptor size. These inline bytes must remain Data.

units.name: B20_JumpNativePrimary
units.summary: Indirect tail call through the primary word.

units.name: B20_NativeShiftWordLeft
units.summary: Copy the selected register word and shift it left by the selected count; a nonzero high count byte becomes 16.

units.name: B20_NativeShiftWordArithmeticRight
units.summary: Preserve sign through repeated right shifts after copying the selected register word.

units.name: B20_NativeShiftWordLogicalRight
units.summary: Zero-fill repeated right shifts of the selected register word.

units.name: B20_LoadNativeShiftOperands
units.summary: Copy the source pair to the destination and decode the shift count. Preserve the copied high byte sign for arithmetic shift selection.

units.name: B20_NativePushWordRegisters
units.summary: Reserve two VM stack bytes and copy the selected register pair in the ABI order.

units.name: B20_NativePushFourRegisters
units.summary: Reserve four VM stack bytes and share the word-push copying tail.

units.name: B20_NativePopWordRegisters
units.summary: Copy two bytes from the VM stack to consecutive selected registers and release them.

units.name: B20_NativePopFourRegisters
units.summary: Copy four bytes from the VM stack and release them.

units.name: B20_NativeInlineSwitch
units.summary: Consume an inline case count and four-byte value/target records, compare against the primary word, then indirect-jump to the matched or default target. The inline table is Data.

units.name: B20_CallGridHelperOnAlternateStack
units.summary: Save the current VM stack, move to the grid workspace stack and call with current linked-object arguments. The paired continuation restores the original stack.

units.name: B20_ExpandOrderedGridCosts
units.summary: Reserve a 168-byte circular queue, initialize two 168-word grids with $7575, seed the requested cell and process neighbors. Insert newly found cells into the queue in cost order by shifting byte indices; wrap head/tail within the workspace. Return one when the optional current-cell target is found, otherwise zero when exhausted.

units.name: B20_IncrementGridCostWord

regions.summary: Update envelopes and advance sequence state for four channels, addressed with X=12,8,4,0 so their state and APU register blocks share stride four. Consume the song-start request only after the channel updates.

units.name: B28_UpdateFourMusicChannels
units.summary: Update envelopes and advance sequence state for four channels, addressed with X=12,8,4,0 so their state and APU register blocks share stride four. Consume the song-start request only after the channel updates.

units.name: B28_StartMusicWhenIdle
units.summary: Wait until all four duration counters are zero. Copy each initial track pointer into current/loop pointers, reset envelope/loop state and select instrument zero. The caller clears the pending-start flag.

units.name: B28_UpdateChannelEnvelope
units.summary: Use the instrument pointer and envelope step to compute volume plus signed adjustment, handle release/hold timers and advance/wrap the envelope index. Update APU volume/control and write the high timer only when its shadow is nonnegative.

units.name: B28_WriteChannelPitchOffset
units.summary: Apply the envelope high-nibble pitch adjustment to the timer low byte, clamping arithmetic overflow/underflow. Noise channel X=12 instead converts the nibble to its noise-period encoding.

units.name: B28_AdvanceMusicChannel
units.summary: Decrement the event duration and gate/release counters. When an event expires, parse control bytes until a note/rest/duration event is reached. Sequence pointers are CPU addresses under the loaded audio bank pair; no runtime playback was observed.

units.name: B28_ReleaseMusicChannel
units.summary: Clear active-envelope and release-hold state and set the release delay to one.

units.name: B28_ReadMusicSequenceCommands
units.summary: Read through the channel cursor. Values below $D5 are event encodings; higher values select volume adjustment, instrument, release timing and loop/repeat controls. Saved cursors implement nested repeat/return points; malformed sequences have no explicit bound here.

units.name: B28_ReadMusicInstrument
units.summary: Consume the following instrument index and select its envelope/control record.

units.name: B28_SetMusicReleaseDelay
units.summary: Read a nonzero global release delay from the next sequence byte.

units.name: B28_SaveMusicReturnCursor
units.summary: Remember the current track cursor as a repeat/return point.

units.name: B28_RestoreMusicReturnCursor
units.summary: Save the secondary cursor before returning to the prior repeat point.

units.name: B28_RestartMusicTrack
units.summary: Save the secondary cursor and restart from the initial track address.

units.name: B28_ReturnToMusicSecondaryCursor
units.summary: Use the saved secondary cursor when present; otherwise end this parsing iteration.

units.name: B28_SaveMusicLoopCursor
units.summary: Save a loop-start cursor and reset the loop counters.

units.name: B28_RepeatMusicLoop
units.summary: Compare the encoded repeat count against the channel loop counter and return to the saved loop cursor while repeats remain.

units.name: B28_FinishMusicRepeatGroup
units.summary: Select or leave the saved repeat cursor based on encoded repeat count and nested-loop state.

units.name: B28_DecodeMusicEvent
units.summary: Interpret note/rest/duration events. Noise and tonal channels differ; explicit durations may consume another byte. Save the updated cursor and gate duration before returning.

units.name: B28_SaveMusicTrackCursor
units.summary: Advance by the consumed bytes and save the resulting pointer with carry across pages.

units.name: B28_SaveMusicSecondaryCursor
units.summary: Remember the current cursor in the channel secondary-return slot.

units.name: B28_SaveMusicRepeatExitCursor
units.summary: Remember where parsing should continue after the current repeat group.

units.name: B28_ReadMusicDuration
units.summary: Use the low five bits as a duration-table index. Zero instead consumes an explicit duration byte; copy the duration to both event and gate counters.

units.name: B28_AddressMusicInstrument
units.summary: Convert the instrument index to a 32-byte record address beginning at CPU $A700; return its pointer in the audio scratch pair.

units.name: B28_SelectMusicInstrument
units.summary: Store the instrument pointer and derive release decrement/delay from its second byte using two small tables.

units.name: B28_SetMusicNotePitch
units.summary: Index the little-endian timer table by note, enable the envelope, and find an envelope starting step that fits the current volume adjustment. Triangle channel bypasses the step search.

phase1.label: VmMemoryStackAndBranchHandlers

regions.summary: Memory handlers choose frame-relative or absolute addresses through shared decoders. Word/byte loads, stores and pushes return to opcode fetch. Later entries form frame addresses, call native addresses, copy memory, adjust the descending stack, and branch by replacing or adding/subtracting the script pointer. Conditions test the primary word for zero; operand readers consume skipped operands too. No game-specific meaning is known.

regions.summary: Sixteen-bit arithmetic over primary and secondary value pairs. Multiplication uses MMC5 8x8 products and keeps the low word. Shift counts use the secondary word; division-by-zero behavior is not checked here.

units.name: B31_DivideSigned32
units.summary: Normalize operand signs, perform unsigned division and negate the quotient when operand signs differ.

units.name: B31_DivideUnsigned32Entry
units.summary: Enter the unsigned division core without sign normalization.

units.name: B31_NormalizeAndDivideSigned32
units.summary: Preserve dividend and quotient signs in scratch $41/$40. Negate negative inputs before restoring division.

units.name: B31_DivideUnsigned32Core
units.summary: Clear the four-byte remainder, shift one dividend bit into it per round and subtract the divisor when it fits. Set each successful quotient bit in the primary word; run exactly 32 rounds. No separate zero-divisor check is present.

units.name: B31_RemainderUnsigned32
units.summary: Divide unsigned operands, copy the four-byte remainder to the primary value and return it without a negative sign.

units.name: B31_RemainderSigned32
units.summary: Divide magnitudes, copy the remainder to the primary value and restore the dividend sign.

units.name: B31_Add32
units.summary: Add the secondary four-byte operand into the primary one, low byte first with carry.

units.name: B31_Subtract32
units.summary: Subtract the secondary operand from the primary four bytes with borrow.

units.name: B31_ShiftLeft32
units.summary: Decrement a four-byte count and shift the primary four-byte value left until the count becomes negative.

units.name: B31_ShiftArithmeticRight32
units.summary: Remember the original sign and shift the primary four bytes right with sign extension, decrementing the four-byte count.

units.name: B31_ShiftLogicalRight32
units.summary: Shift right with zero fill while decrementing the four-byte count.

units.name: B31_Complement32
units.summary: Invert all four primary bytes.

units.name: B31_And32
units.summary: Intersect the primary and secondary four-byte values.

units.name: B31_Or32
units.summary: Combine the primary and secondary four-byte values by OR.

units.name: B31_Xor32
units.summary: Combine the primary and secondary four-byte values by exclusive OR.

units.name: B31_Negate32
units.summary: Subtract the primary four bytes from zero, low byte first. Callers supply the carry/Y state required by this compact helper.

units.name: B31_LogicalNot32
units.summary: Test the primary four-byte value for zero, then invert the predicate in A. The stored primary boolean remains the nonzero result; this leaf does not store the inverted A back.

units.name: B31_LogicalNonzero32
units.summary: Return a word boolean according to whether any primary byte is nonzero.

units.name: B31_Equal32
units.summary: Compare all four operand bytes from high to low and return a word boolean.

units.name: B31_NotEqual32
units.summary: Compare all four operand bytes and return the opposite equality boolean.

units.name: B31_SignedLess32
units.summary: Compare primary minus secondary and correct the sign test for overflow.

units.name: B31_UnsignedLess32
units.summary: Compare primary minus secondary and return the inverse carry as a word boolean.

units.name: B31_SignedGreater32
units.summary: Compare secondary minus primary and correct its sign for overflow.

units.name: B31_UnsignedGreater32
units.summary: Compare secondary minus primary and return the inverse carry.

units.name: B31_SignedLessEqual32
units.summary: Compare secondary minus primary and invert the signed-negative result.

units.name: B31_UnsignedLessEqual32
units.summary: Compare secondary minus primary and return carry.

units.name: B31_SignedGreaterEqual32
units.summary: Compare primary minus secondary and invert the signed-negative result.

units.name: B31_UnsignedGreaterEqual32
units.summary: Compare primary minus secondary and return carry.

units.name: B31_ComparePrimaryMinusSecondary32
units.summary: Propagate subtraction flags across all four bytes; clear the high boolean result byte while preserving carry/overflow from the final subtraction.

units.name: B31_CompareSecondaryMinusPrimary32
units.summary: Perform the reversed four-byte comparison for greater/less-equal variants.

units.name: B31_SignExtendWordTo32
units.summary: Replicate the primary word sign into bytes +2/+3. Y is zero on the nonnegative entry contract.

units.name: B31_ZeroExtendWordTo32
units.summary: Store the caller-provided zero byte in both upper primary bytes; this is the nonnegative/sign-extension shared tail.

units.name: B31_ExtendedImmediateReturn
units.summary: Return immediately; a reserved extended entry aliases this return.

units.name: B31_ReadPrimaryImmediate32
units.summary: Read four bytes from the script cursor into the primary value and advance the bytecode cursor.

units.name: B31_ReadSecondaryImmediate32
units.summary: Read four bytes from the script cursor into the secondary value and advance the cursor.

units.name: B31_Decrement32
units.summary: Prepare a -1 addend and share the carry-propagating increment/decrement tail.

units.name: B31_Increment32
units.summary: Add one to the primary four bytes, propagating carry through the remaining bytes.

units.name: B31_Store32ThroughPoppedAddress
units.summary: Pop the destination word from the VM stack and store all four primary bytes through it.

units.name: B31_SwapPrimarySecondary32
units.summary: Exchange the two four-byte operands.

units.name: B31_LoadPrimary32FromAddressMode
units.summary: Resolve the VM addressing mode and copy four bytes to the primary value.

units.name: B31_LoadSecondary32FromAddressMode
units.summary: Resolve the VM addressing mode and copy four bytes to the secondary value.

units.name: B31_StorePrimary32ToAddressMode
units.summary: Resolve the VM addressing mode and store four primary bytes.

units.name: B31_Dispatch32AddressOperation
units.summary: Use the addressing-mode selector bits to choose primary load, secondary load, store or push-four-bytes behavior.

units.name: B31_Dispatch32SecondaryAddressOperation
units.summary: Resolve the next addressing-mode selector bit before the secondary-load branch.

units.name: B31_Dispatch32StoreAddressOperation
units.summary: Resolve the next addressing-mode selector bit before the primary-store branch.

units.name: B31_Dispatch32PushAddressOperation
units.summary: Resolve the next addressing-mode selector bit before the four-byte-push branch.

units.name: B31_Resolve32PushSource

units.name: B31_MoveSplitScrollRows

units.name: B31_ConfigureMapperSplit
units.summary: Reset the split row shadow, pack enable/side/column fields into MMC5 split control and set the split bank.

units.name: B31_ConfigureFlashingSpriteGroup
units.summary: When enabled, prepare four OAM records in a two-by-two eight-pixel arrangement from the supplied tile bytes, position and attributes. Set the first index, timer and enable state used by the existing flash consumer.

units.name: B31_LoadSongWithTemporaryBanks
units.summary: Save $8000/$A000 PRG shadows and select FC/FD. Physical banks 28/29 follow only under MMC5 mode 3 and the recorded ROM geometry. Stop existing audio, traverse length-prefixed objects at CPU $8500, resolve four relative tracks and enable APU channels. Restore both banks in reverse order.

units.name: B31_SetSongRestartMode
units.summary: Store the requested restart mode for the idle-song consumer.

units.name: B31_StopMusicChannels
units.summary: Hold the interrupt transfer lock, disable APU channels and clear four active duration/envelope states. Restore the lock after resetting release timers.

units.name: B31_QueryMusicActive
units.summary: OR the pending song-start flag and four duration counters; return service result one if any is active.
